article.title: Why We Rally for Palestine
article.author: Rochester Red Star: News from Rochester DSA
article.content: by Logan W. Cole The following remarks were made in front of Batavia City Hall at Genesee County DSA’s Rally for Palestine on October 3 rd , 2026. This is a reminder as to why we’re still here as we rally on behalf of the Palestinian people in Batavia today – this has all happened since October of 2023: More than 75,000 Palestinians confirmed killed (but more likely hundreds of thousands); More than 174,000 wounded including the highest per-capita rate of child amputees; More than 1,400 killed (that we know of – the Gaza Health Ministry lacks the infrastructure to fully count such deaths) and more than 5,000 injured since the ostensible “ceasefire” last October; More than 10,000 under rubble ; More than 20,000 children killed ; More than 2 million displaced in Gaza – this is more than 91% of the population; More than 267 out of ~1,000 Palestinian journalists in Gaza killed ( more than 26%); More than 9,000 Palestinian political prisoners detained; and More than 92% of homes have been destroyed in Gaza. We stand with people of Palestine, who continue to experience a genocide committed against them by the state of Israel with the backing of the United States government. There are some actions we can take. We can let our voices be heard, as we are today, and we should continue to do so. We can withhold our vote from those candidates who support the genocide. We can support the BDS (Boycott, Divestment, and Sanctions) movement and withhold votes from, and oppose efforts of, those who stifle the speech of those who support BDS. We can stand against, and support the abolition of, Immigration Customs and Enforcement (ICE), who have targeted immigrants like Mahmoud Khalil , Leqaa Kordia , and Rümeysa Öztürk who speak out on behalf of Palestinians – it is one struggle and Batavia, especially with the proposed detention center expansion, is one front in the struggle. It’s not complicated. We can’t stop talking about Gaza. Today, we rally for a permanent, actual ceasefire in Gaza, a halt to all sales of weapons used to commit atrocities against the Palestinian people, and a free Palestine from the Jordan River to the Mediterranean Sea.
